readings: For each transaction in `sentimentandfundamentals` (`transref`), take the average analyst coverage count (`anlycount`, ignoring missing values). Keep only the transactions whose average is above the overall average of those per-transaction averages. For each one, show `transref`, its average, how far it is above that overall average, and how far it is above the average among just the kept transactions. Give me the top 10 by that last difference, highest first (missing last). Don't round.
queries:
WITH per_transaction AS (
    SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
    FROM per_transaction
),
kept AS (
    SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg
    FROM per_transaction AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg
),
kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg
    FROM kept
)
SELECT
    k.transref,
    k.avg_anlycount,
    k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
    k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
